question: What is the smallest prospectively weight-ordered prefix of the causally validated upstream writers that faithfully reconstructs each task-typed L11H3 value-source effect?

frozen_design.populations: Run all 128 endpoints in both the original and fresh OOD banks. Temporal remains locked to bridge and is-was to postcue; donor pairing, rows, phases, templates, and source positions cannot be reselected.
frozen_design.intervention: For each role, patch absolute native-donor pre-c_proj head slices for prefixes P1 through P5 at only the locked source positions. Every selected earlier head is patched in its own layer; all unselected components and L11H3 itself remain live. Independently rerun the direct L11H3:value patch as the parent reference.
frozen_design.selection: Read only pooled original FIT. Select the smallest weight-ordered prefix with signed recovery in [0.50,1.50], cosine >=0.90, relative residual <=0.75, and direction agreement >=0.90 against the live L11H3:value reference. If no prefix qualifies, return a registered greedy-selection null without inspecting validation to choose another set.
frozen_design.validation: The selected prefix is frozen independently per role. It must have signed recovery in [0.50,1.75], cosine >=0.90, relative residual <=0.90, and direction agreement >=0.90 on original HOLDOUT and both OOD phases. Every per-template validation row must retain nonnegative recovery and direction agreement >=0.75.
frozen_design.compactness: A role is compact only if its selected prefix is shorter than five. The cross-task program is compact if at least one role prunes and neither role fails validation. Report overlap of selected physical heads without requiring identical task prefixes.
frozen_design.selectivity: For each selected-prefix pooled phase, command-gold cross-role norm ratio must be <=0.01; every is-was intervention must change the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5. Reference replay must be exact within 1e-5.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_reference_repla: Both immutable authorities, task banks, locked positions, native references, prefix inventory, capture coverage, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_original_fit_selects_a_qualified_: Each role has at least one prefix satisfying the frozen selection bar on pooled original FIT.
predictions.pred_c_selected_prefixes_validate_withou: Both FIT-selected prefixes pass every pooled and template-level original HOLDOUT/OOD validation bar.
predictions.pred_d_greedy_prunes_at_least_one_overco: At least one role selects fewer than five heads while both selected prefixes validate.
predictions.pred_e_selected_prefixes_are_task_select: All selected-prefix collateral and later-to-earlier causal-zero bars pass.

null: If A fails, the instrument is invalid. If B fails, weight order is not a sufficient greedy path and no validation-driven subset may be substituted. If B passes but C fails, the prefix is an original-FIT overfit and the complete top-five remains only the licensed sufficient set. If C passes but D fails, the program is validated but not pruned. Any failure preserves L9H1/L9H4 singleton writer licenses and cannot reopen candidate widening, source positions, DAS, or the interaction-aware branch.
decision: A/B/C/E licenses the selected task-typed prefixes as compact upstream writers into the exact L11H3 source-term interface. D determines whether the causal circuit is simpler than the complete top-five unions. The successor is held-out writer-to-formula mediation, not another head search.
